name: justtranscribe
description: Transcribe public videos and audio into timestamped text, summaries and subtitles.

interface.longDescription:
JustTranscribe turns public videos and audio into accurate, timestamped text inside ChatGPT. Paste a YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, Pinterest or Google Drive link and ask for the transcript, a summary, subtitles or the key moments; the text comes back with timestamps, speaker labels on conversations, and the language detected automatically. Spanish, English and Portuguese are first-class, with dozens of other languages supported.

What you can do:
• Transcribe a public video or audio link (up to 150 minutes).
• Read the transcript back as plain text or with timestamps and speakers.
• Export subtitles (SRT, VTT) or text (TXT, Markdown, CSV).
• List and delete the transcripts on your account.

Your JustTranscribe account keeps every transcript in its library at justtranscribe.ai, where you can also upload your own recordings (WhatsApp voice notes, classes, meetings, interviews) and export to Word. Sign in with Google or email.

Privacy: transcripts belong to you, are never used for training, and can be deleted at any time from ChatGPT or the website.
